explanations: invalidate() correctly leaves a marker with the written version, so the cache knows the row moved on. fill() only checks that version against live entries, though (existing?.live && ...). A page load that read version 1 before a reservation, and finishes after the reservation invalidated the key at version 2, overwrites the marker and caches the old counts for the full TTL. The fix compares against any existing slot, live or invalidated, so a fill with an older version than the cache knows about is rejected. The next read misses, loads version 2, and caches that.
